components.css: .ds-evidence{font:15px/1.65 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#172f30);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#ced7d2);padding:14px 0}.ds-evidence summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-evidence pre{font:12px/1.65 Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;background:#eef1ed;padding:16px;border-radius:5px;max-height:440px;overflow:auto}.ds-evidence summary:focus-visible,.ds-evidence pre:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#a44700);outline-offset:3px}
